message.content:
Here’s a list of the long weekends (public holidays that fall on or create a three‑day weekend) in Canada for the year 2023.  (Note that the exact dates can vary by province, but the following are the nationwide or most common long weekends.)

| Date | Holiday | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **January 1 (2023)** | New Year’s Day | Falls on a Sunday – the following Monday (Jan 2) is a statutory holiday in most provinces. |
| **January 16 (2023)** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Creates a long weekend in those provinces. |
| **February 20 (2023)** | Louis‑Riel Day (Manitoba) | Creates a long weekend in Manitoba. |
| **March 20 (2023)** | Good Friday | Creates a long weekend in all provinces. |
| **April 7 (2023)** | Victoria Day (British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland & Labrador) | Creates a long weekend in those provinces. |
| **May 22 (2023)** | Victoria Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | Creates a long weekend in Newfoundland & Labrador. |
| **May 29 (2023)** | Victoria Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | Creates a long weekend in Newfoundland & Labrador. |
| **June 19 (2023)** | Canada Day (all provinces) | Creates a long weekend in all provinces. |
| **July 1 (2023)** | Canada Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | Creates a long weekend in Newfoundland & Labrador. |
| **July 2 (2023)** | Canada Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | Creates a long weekend in Newfoundland & Labrador. |
| **August 7 (2023)** | Civic Holiday (Ontario, Prince Edward Island, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland & Labrador) | Creates a long weekend in those provinces. |
| **September 18 (2023)** | Labour Day (all provinces) | Creates a long weekend in all provinces. |
| **October 9 (2023)** | Thanksgiving (all provinces) | Creates a long weekend in all provinces. |
| **November 20 (2023)** | Remembrance Day (all provinces) | Creates a long weekend in all provinces. |
| **December 25 (2023)** | Christmas Day (all provinces) | Creates a long weekend in all provinces. |
| **December 26 (2023)** | Boxing Day (all provinces) | Creates a long weekend in all provinces. |

**Key points to remember**

* **Provincial variations** – Some holidays (e.g., Family Day, Louis‑Riel Day, Victoria Day) are observed only in certain provinces, so the long weekend will apply only there.
* **Statutory holidays** – In many provinces, if a holiday falls on a weekend, the following weekday is a statutory holiday. For example, New Year’s Day fell on a Sunday in 2023, so Monday, Jan 2 was a holiday in most provinces.
* **Holiday substitutions** – If a holiday falls on a weekend, the holiday may be observed on the nearest weekday. This can affect the long weekend calculation.

Feel free to let me know if you need the list broken down by province or if you’d like additional details (e.g., exact dates for each province).
